narr: Deep lower and mid level moisture remained trapped under an upper high centered over the Rockies. A weak disturbance moving through northeast flow triggered slow moving storms over the Sacramento Mountains and brought flash flooding to the Soldier Canyon burn scar.
ev: Highway 70 was closed between mile markers 242 and 247. Heavy debris was across the road near mile marker 242. Rainfall amounts in excess of 1 inch in an hour were recorded near the burn scar.
lsr: HIGHWAY 70 CLOSED BETWEEN MILE MARKERS 242 AND 247. HEAVY DEBRIS ACROSS THE ROAD NEAR MILE MARKER 242. RAINFALL AMOUNTS IN EXCESS OF 1 INCH IN LAST HOUR.
